tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ja)༄༅/ /jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha siṃ
(ja)༄༅/ /jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha siṃ

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru buddha siṃ hā ya/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas mthar/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ ljang nag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad sbyangs/ khro bo'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ljang nag g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dang smin ma kham ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsnol ba/ bar pa gnyis kyis gser gyi rdo rje dang dril bu gdengs pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang se ral khar byas pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ utstshuṣma kro dhā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni sogs nas hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te hūm̐ la thim par bsams nas/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ ma hā prā ṇā ya/ bhūrtsi bhūrki bi ma la utstshuṣma ma hā kro dhā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ ri li shu tharsha hurshi bi ma le utstshuṣma ma hā kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas nas/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro bo'i rgyal po 'grub gyur nas// sogs brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam gang shes bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs bu gtsang mar padma 'dab brgyad rdul tshon nam ras 'dul la bris pa'i steng du bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang du/

bum sman nyer lnga dang bcas pa ku shas kha brgyan pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gis gang ba'i gzungs rdor dang bcas pa bkod pa'i mthar/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang*/ byang shar nas shar lho'i bar gtor ma gsum dang*/ gzhan yang rdor dril me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog sogs nas/ rnams dwangs shing thog pa med par nam mkha'i mtha' klad par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ zhes pa nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas/ rang la thim/ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar bya'o// bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du pam̐ las padma sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs shlo ka gsum gyis spyan drangs te/ bdag nyid zer ba de nyid 'don pa bsgyur ro// oṃ utstshuṣma kro dhā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ zhes pa nas/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas/ shabda rol chen dang*/ bstod pa ni/ pad nyi'i gdan steng hūm̐ las byung*// sku mdog ljang nag khros pa'i zhal// g.yas sngo g.yon dkar spyan gsum bgrad// bdud 'joms mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag drug dang pos sdigs mdzub bsnol// bar pa rdo rje dril bu gdengs// tha ma lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin// dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod// sbrul rgyan stag gi sham thabs can// ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i dbus// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// don gnyis sgrub la phyag 'tshal bstod// de ltar bstod pas 'gro kun gyis// sku gsum ye shes lnga thob nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar// 'gro ba'i don ni byed par shog

/gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog sogs gyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pas sogs gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa ni/ chos skyong rgyal chen bzhi la dbul te byin rlabs sogs nas phrin las bcol ba'i bar tshe dpag med kyi nang bzhin bya/ mthar badzra muḥs gshegs gsol bya'o// gsum pa ni/ 'bru gsum gyi byin rlabs sngar bzhin bya/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di sogs nas/ shog bar gyis phrin las bcol lo// gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon te song bas bum nang gi lha la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ sngags gnyis brgya tsam bzlas so// mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsir gyur/ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu'o// slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu sogs grub nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs mdor bsdus bshad nas/ de lta bu'i blo can la ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas mdo sngags gnyis las sngags yin/

de la yang rgyud sde'i dbye sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa'i nang nas bya rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ 'dir bya ba spyi'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang dpung bzang dang*/ legs grub dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma dang*/ gsang ba spyi'i rgyud dang bzhi las/ 'dir kri ya dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ jo bo chen po rje'i zhal nas legs par bkral ba'i gnas skabs su dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ 'khon grib mi gtsang ba thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ gnyis pa khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro la maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ thog par slob dpon la khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa dngos yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i phyir khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa yi dam du stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sogs nas/

yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ 'grub par shog ces pa sngon 'gro yin la/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par mos nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pam̐ las padma sogs nas/ dbur brgyan par mos nas slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyis spyi bo nas thim pas/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du khro bo'i rgyal po zhes pa nas bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur ba'i slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon zhes pa nas/ dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang gis sangs rgyas la// dbang bskur bzhin du 'gro ba rnams// rgyal zhing yon tan 'byung ba'i dbang*// de bzhin bdag la'ang gnang bar mdzod// ces brjod nas sku de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba de slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur sbyin// oṃ sarba sogs nas hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par mos/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi bar chad nyams grib zhi bar byas/ lus khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sku'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gsal btab nas/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa spyan drangs te slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos nas sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig mdzod/ oṃbhūrkuṃ sogs brjod/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul gyis me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ sngags kyi dngos grub brtan par mdzod// lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das sme ba brtsegs pa'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ces sogs gong gi ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur ro// thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bla ma dang yi dam la thim par mos/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim par mos/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams la sogs nas/

hūm̐ la thim sogs nas/ zhu nas zhabs kyu la thim sogs nas/ khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ nā da de yang je phrar song nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gyur nas/ slar yang rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa snang stong ngam/ gsal stong ngam/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ces sogs ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur ro// des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ maṇḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ rjes ni/ bum pa la mchod pa byin brlab/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs/ dge ba 'di yis sogs nas/ ston mchog dam pa sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// glo bur gzhan gyi grib sel bar 'dod na rjes gnang ma gtogs gzhan snga ma ltar bya'o// las tshogs rnams yi ge rnying pa ltar gang mos la phyag len bya'o// de ltar kri ya dpung bzang nas gsungs pa// jo bo rje yis legs par bkral ba 'dis// gnas skabs nyams grib 'khon dang mi gtsang sogs// zhi nas mthar thug sme brtsegs thob par shog /ces pa 'di'ang bha danta ga ga na shrī bha dras dran gsor byas pa'o// slob ma'am sbyin bdag la khrus mchog byed na/ lha'i mtshan dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas bkra shis kyi bar rnam 'joms bzhin bya'o// ༈ /khro bo sme brtsegs ljang nag gi las tshogs bzhugs/ 'di'i las tshogs ni/ nad dang grib kyis phog pa srung na/ changs bu dang theb kyu nyer gcig re/ bal nag gi srung skud rnams sta gon bya/ bdag bskyed bum bzlas gtor ma rnams gong bzhin byas la/ nad pa'am grib phog pa de chu gtsang mas bkrus la chu de snod gcig tu bzhag la/ de nas bum pa'i chu khro bo 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsir bsam/ nad pa grib can bkru zhing*/

oṃ bhūrkuṃ sogs sngags gnyis dang*/ oṃ e ho sogs kyi mthar/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ dam grib thams cad/ nal grib thams cad/ yugs sa dang ro grib/ mdze dang dme grib/ nad dang gdon gyi grib/ gnas dang gos ngan grib/ zas grib phog pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas bkru/ sbyong ba la/ zhi bas sbyong ba ni/ snod gcig tu changs bu gcig dang*/ theb kyu re bcug nas/ chus bran la/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes brjod/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs sngags lan gsum dang*/ nad pa la gtor mas bskor la/ sngar gyi dri ma bkrus pa'i chu logs su bzhag pa der blug go /de lta bu'i gzungs nyer gcig gi mthar/ gtor ma phyir 'phangs la phyi mig mi blta'o// drag pos sbyong ba ni/ gong gi sngags gsum bzlas pa'i gu gul gyis bsgrub bya bdug khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdo rje dril bu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa thugs kar bsnol/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs nas/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bden pa zhes sogs spyi dang mthun/ khyad par du yang khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ che ge mos tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar la/ lus ngag yid gsum la gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces lan gsum dang*/ gong gi srung skud bzhi la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa brgyab pa'i srung ba byas/ rkang lag gi srin lag bzhi la btags/ slar yang sngags rnams brjod cing*/ bsgrub bya la dam grib phog pa thams cad srin lag bzhi'i skud pa la bstims te/

gri gsar pas skud pa bcad la/ gong du bshad pa'i chu dang gtor ma dang mnyam du bskyal ba sogs bya'o// de lta bu lan gsum mam lnga byas na nad pa mi sos mi srid do// rang lam du 'gro dus grib sogs byung dogs yod na/ zas kyi phud lhag ma dang bcas pa cung zad la gtor ma gcig byas te/ rang khro bor bsgoms la/ khro bo'i sngags dang*/ chos skyong gang byed kyi sngags brgya rtsa bzlas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun bskyed dang khro bo'am chos skyong gang byed skad cig gis bsam/ gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rung gis phul/ grib zhi ba'i phrin las bcol/ gong gi sngags rnams bzlas shing lam du 'gro/ smyon pa 'dul na gu gul nag po sngags rnams kyis bdug la bsreg nad pa'i snying ga la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la/ gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam/ ser ba srung na/ khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sngags bzlas shing sdigs mdzub bstan pas ser ba'i rkang chag go /rims nad gso na/ bum pa spos kyi chus bkang la/ yungs kar la sngags mang du bzlas pa bum pa'i nang du blugs/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug bum chu nad pa'i khong par btang la khrus kyang bya'o// phyugs la god kha sogs byung na/ thar nu/ ra dug bong nga dkar nag dmar gsum la phyugs la gang gnod pa'i 'gong po'i gzugs byas la/ seng ldeng gi phur pa sor bzhi la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ phyugs nad yod sa la 'khrus chu la sngags btab ste gtor/ gong gi gnod byed kyi gzugs kyi snying gar phur bu btab la phyogs gzhan du rbad do// mi lo nad can gyi nad gso na/ shog bu la nad pa'i gzugs bris/ snying gar ming bris la nad bdag gang yin de bkug la ming yig la bstim/ nad pa'i mal 'og tu bcug la/ nad pa la dmigs pa gtad la sngags bzlas shing nad pa la btab bo// ra lug la spyang ki byung na/ ra lug pho mo gang yin gyi mgul du sngags bris la btags so// 'bras dang phol dang lhog pa gso na/

nad pa'i sngas su gu gul nag po bsreg cing bzlas la brgyab bo// nad pa'i sngas srung byed na/ mgar ba'i so mal la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing nad pa la brab bo// zhing la 'bu srin srung na/ tshwa dang yungs kar bsres la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la btab ste zhing gi mtha' bskor/ rlung phyogs nas brgya rtsa brgyad btab na gzhan du 'gro'o// bang mdzod du 'gong po zhugs nas sris la gnod na/ tsandan dkar po'am shug pa la phur bu sor bcu gnyis byas pa dar nag gi cod pan btags la/ khro bo chen po bskyed nas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ thod pa mtshan ldan cig 'bru nag pos bkang la phur bu btsugs nas bang mdzod du sbas na 'gong pos gnod pa mi byed do// nor phyugs la 'gong po rjes su 'brangs nas gnod pa byas na/ drag po'i thab khung gi nang du tsher ma can gyi shing la me sbar me de bsang sbyang*/ khro bo chen po yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ 'gong po can nor phyugs kyi bdag po de'i skra sen zas lhag gos kyi dri ma bsres pa'i liṅga la 'gug gzhug yang yang bya/ mtshon gyis dum bur gtubs la/ sngags sum brgya bzlas shing bsreg khro bos zhal du gsol bar bsams la/ gnod byed kyi ming nas brjod cing kha kha khā hi khā hi mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ bsregs zin pa dang lha rang la bstim mo// dge 'dun gyi sde'am yul phyogs kyi chu mig gam/ rang rang gi chu ra'i nang du rdo la khro bo'i sku brkos la btsugs nas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ chu la longs spyod na grib dang mi gtsang ba sogs kyi gnod pa mi 'byung*/ gtsang stag tshal gyi gnas na/ mdo sde 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhugs/ de'i bya ba yongs su bstan pa'i mdo las/ sde 'khrugs byed pa'i mi rnams dmyal bar skyes pa'i tshe tshad gsungs te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal pa/ btsun pas dmag dpon byas pa'i tshe tshad ni/

bskal pa grangs med du sems can dmyal bar skye/ mi skyas dmag dpon byas pa ni bskal pa drug cu/ 'thab tu mi 'gro yang kha phyogs byas pa tsam bskal pa brgyad/ kha phyogs mi byed kyang zhe phyogs nas dga' bar byed pa bskal pa bdun la dmyal bar skye/ 'khrugs pa la mi gtogs kyang de'i dus su mi shi tshad 'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad la gnod par bshad/ sde 'khrugs byed sar der sgrub pa byas kyang*/ sa tshig pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung gsungs so// de phyir bskal pa dus kyi snyigs mar sde 'khrugs dar bar gsungs pas/ de'i dus khro bo sme brtsegs sgrub pa gal che gsungs/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra la sde 'khrugs bya ba ci la zer zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dge slong nang 'khrugs byed pa la zer gsungs so// de'i gnyen por 'di gsungs nas/ khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs 'di gnang nas khro bo 'di yi dam du byas na/ dme dgu brtsegs pa'i sde 'khrugs sar sdod kyang mi gnod/ nyes pa mi phog gsungs so// mdo nang nas kyang gzungs 'di gsungs so// oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ oṃ e baṃ raṃ shuddhe shuddhe/ a a a swā hā/ rgya mtsho thal bar dkrugs kyang nyam mi nga*// gzungs 'di bzlas na nyams grib gos mi 'gyur// 'di yang sme brtsegs kyi gzungs bzlas rjes bzlas te sde 'khrugs kyi gnyen po yin no/ mang du spel cig 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi kri ya dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud nas gsungs/ de nas jo bo dī paṃ ka ras bod du spyan drangs/ dge bshes ston pa dang*/ nag tsho sogs la gnang*/ dge bshes ston pa sku mched gsum la gnang yang gsungs so// ༈ /sme brtsegs ljang dud la brten pa'i grib glud rdzong chog 'gal rkyen mun sel khro bo'i gzi 'od bzhugs so// swa sti/

sme brtsegs ljang nag jo lugs dang dud kha sa lugs khog gcig pas dud khar bkru byabs srung gsum dang sbrags/ grib glud gtong tshul mkhyen rab chos rje'i snag dbon bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad par lung dang phyag len bzhugs pas/ de nyid sme brtsegs jo lugs la sbyar te bkru byabs srung ba dang ma 'brel bar gnas skabs gzhan du gtong tshul ni bum chog gi chas rnams paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yig cha bzhin dang grib glud kyi chas 'bru sna tshogs tshad tshig phye nag por song ba'i rtsam pa la grib gtor nag po gru gsum rtse dang ldem la sgor rgyan/ bsgrub bya'i dri khu las brdzis pa'i glud/ dril zan la grib bdag mtshon byed mi gos thod nag po gyon cing lag gnyis dar nag 'dzin pa rta nag sga srab sogs chas 'grig la zhon pa'i rgyab tu 'jag ma sogs la brten pa'i bya nag klad du lding ba khyi nag rjes su 'brang ba/ gzhan yang mi lus bya/ sbrul/ phag sbal pa'i mgo can lag cha med pa bzos la/ snod gcig gi nang du gtor ma de'i rgyab tu grib bdag dpon g.yog mdun du glud dang changs bu mtha' skor du 'khon yugs dme pho sogs kyi lag nas byung ba'i zas sogs dngos po sna tshogs bya ded spyang ded kyi sha sogs grib che rigs gang 'byor bzhag chab kyis bran/ nyams len gyi rim pa mchod pa byin rlabs nas bum nang gi lha zhu zin pa'i bar thar rtse paṇa chen gyi yig cha bzhin byas la glud gtor sngags drug phyag drug gis byin brlabs pa ni/ lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sbyar/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis spel/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs bar ma bcag par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis bgegs bskrad/ lag pa g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twātā oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis mnyam por thob par bsam/ lag g.yon sngar bzhin g.yas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis tshims par bsam/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa nang bcings byas pa'i mthe bong dpral bar bzhag pa dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ gra he shwa rai pra bhañdza te ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par bsam/ de nas/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la ting 'dzin gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= khyad par du khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas glud len sar 'dir mchis te so so'i gzugs brnyan la thim par gyur cig

ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa dang lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril rgya kye rdor sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin tshar gsum/ rol mo hod kyi len pa sogs phur zlog gtor ma'i dam ye gshegs pa'i zlog pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu'i 'gor byed pa bzhin la dgu brdung gnyis rnga phyir brdung gis/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs// dregs 'joms rgyal po he ru ka /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dang*// grib bdag thams cad nga la nyon// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// mun pa nag po'i gting rum du// grib mkhar nag po'i nang shed na// grib bdag nag po chen po khyod// sku mdog nag la mun pa'i mdog /chibs su grib rta nag po chibs// grib gos nag po rgyab la gyon// grib dar nag po lag na 'phyar// grib 'phru nag po mgo la btsugs// grib bya nag po klad la lding*// grib khyi nag po rgyab tu 'khrid// grib bdag chen pos grib longs shig /de yi bka' nyan las byed pa// 'dod chags bya nag mgo bo can// zhe sdang sbrul nag mgo bo can// gti mug phag nag mgo bo can// ma rig sbal nag mgo bo can// khyod ni grib kyi bdag po yin// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// zas grib gos grib nor gyi grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams sangs gyur cig /mdze grib btsog grib yugs sa'i grib// de 'dra'i= dmar grib dam grib gdon gyi grib// de 'dra'i= lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin grib// de 'dra'i= rgyal po 'byung po 'gong po'i grib// de 'dra'i= the'u rang dri za gnod byed bgegs// de 'dra'i= nyon mongs dug lnga las kyi grib// de 'dra'i= sngar gyi khas blangs nyams chags grib// de 'dra'i= grib bdag chen pos grib sol cig /grib bdag khyod la brdzongs btab bo// 'bru srid 'bru nag tshig phye la// grib gtor nag po'i dam rdzas dang*// ngar mi lan chags changs bu dang*// grib yon cha ma cho dgu dang*// grib bdag khyod la brdzongs btab bo// grib bdag chen pos grib sol cig

/nor grib kyi rjes/ de 'dra'i dang*/ cha ma cho dgu'i mjug gi/ grib sol cig la tshig re la dgu brdung*/ yang*/ hūm̐ nga ni khro rgyal nas/ cha ma cho dgu'i mjug gi/ grib sol cig bar tshar gsum sogs byas la mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e baṃ raṃ shuddhe shuddhe a a a swā hā/ zhes se gol gtogs la lan nyer gcig sogs kyis bsngos/ thal mo sbyar te/ grib rdzas las grub pa'i gtor glud grib yon sna tshogs dang bcas pa grib bdag gang 'dod kyi yon tan dang ldan pa 'dis gnod byed 'khor bcas tshims nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa grib kyi gnod pa las grol bar gyur cig yang rnga brdung*/ glud gtor rnams kha phyir bsgyur/ rtsam lam btang la/ kye/ grib bdag khyod la lam bstan pa// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// mun pa nag po'i klong dkyil na// grib yul mun pa nag re skyid// grib mkhar nag po rdzong re btsan// grib mkhar nag po'i gting rum du// grib bdag chen po der song zhig /'di na khyod kyi gnas ma mchis// grib nad gsol la der song zhig /grib bdag rang rang gnas su gshegs// tshig rol dgu brdung*/ kyai/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi// mgo nad sprin ltar gtibs pa de// grib bdag rgyal po khyod la byol// lce nad rlung bzhin g.yo ba de// grib bdag= snying nad me ltar 'bar ba de// grib bdag= mchin nad nya ltar 'phar ba de// grib bdag= nang cha bu dgu na ba de// grib bdag= mkhal nad chu ltar 'khrugs pa de// grib bdag= sna nad zhang zhum na ba de// grib bdag= phung po lnga po na ba de// grib bdag= ma mo phur bu na ba de// grib bdag= mig dang so la na ba de// grib bdag=

rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// bcings pa yod na dgrol du gsol// mnan pa yod na bteg tu gsol// sbyin bdag lus ngag yid gsum la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs// 'dre gdon rigs gyur thams cad rnams// nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// lus kyang dum bur gtubs 'gyur phyir// glud bdag rnams kyis glud 'di khyer// tshig rol dgu brdung*/ hūm̐/ grib bdag shar gyi phyogs su song*// shar phyogs dri za'i phyogs su song*// dri za'i gdon rnams sangs gyur cig /grib bdag lho yi= lho phyogs gshin rje'i yul du song*// gshin rje'i grib= grib bdag nub kyi phyogs= nub phyogs klu yi phyogs= klu yi grib= grib bdag byang gi= byang phyogs gnod sbyin= gnod sbyin grib= phyogs bzhi dang ni mtshams brgyad dang*// steng 'og gdon rnams da song zhig /phyogs mtshams gang na gnas pa'i gdon// grib bdag chen po rang gnas song*// da lta nyid du mi 'gro na// rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor pas// thal ba'i rdul du rlag par byed// myur ba nyid du da lta song*// tshig rol dgu brdung byas la rnga rol bzhag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas= chos= dge 'dun= gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzung sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= khyad par du khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i lha tshogs rnams= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad glud 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du song zhig

gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing kun tu rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o// zhes brjod cing rdor dril gsor dkrol drag rol drag dung*/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug yungs kar gyis brabs te bgegs rnams rang gnas su song bar bsams la/ glud gtor 'dre lnga phyogs su bskyal/ mjug chog sbyong khrus sogs bya'o// yang bkru byabs srung gsum dang sbrel nas byed na ljang dud gang ltar yang gong gi snag dbon yi ge bzhin la/ de nas mi gsal ba rnams 'di nas kha bskangs te nyams su blangs pas 'thus so// zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos 'phral du bris pa'i 'di'i rnga rol tshig rang rang lag len gang bde byas chog go/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
